items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Dayton-Phoenix Group社に対し、Ohio Tax Credit Authorityが雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認。8年間1.303%の控除で、115人の新規雇用と年間$5.5Mの新規給与創出を約束。
items.infer: Dayton-Phoenix Groupは電動機・発電機部品を手がける機械製造業者であり、雇用増加に伴い生産設備・加工機の増強投資が伴う可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a tax exemption (Data Center Sales Tax Exemption or JCTC-type exemption) of 1.303% for 8 years on 2024-06-24 for a project in the City of Dayton, Montgomery County. Commitment: create 115 full-time equivalent employees generating $5,500,000 in new annual payroll at
